| title = Polychrome
| image = Joker (Polychrome).png
| type = Edition
| effect = {{xmult|1.5}}
}}
'''Polychrome''' is an [[:Category:Editions|edition card modifier]] that gives {{xmult|1.5}} when on a playing card or [[Jokers|Joker]]. Polychrome playing cards give {{xmult|1.5}} when played or retriggered, and Polychrome Jokers give {{xmult|1.5}} when Jokers are calculated, (''after'' playing cards are scored.)

Polychrome adds {{hl|yellow|+{{Money|5}}}} to the [[buy price]] of jokers and playing cards (with {{v|Illusion}}).

==Acquisition==
* By default, Jokers in the shop or generated by {{Tarot|Judgement}} have a {{hl|orange|0.3%}} chance to be Polychrome. This becomes {{hl|orange|0.9%}} with {{v|Hone}} and {{hl|orange|2.1%}} with {{v|Glow Up}}.
* [[Standard Packs]] can generate Polychrome playing cards, with a {{hl|orange|1.2%}} chance by default, {{hl|orange|2.4%}} with Hone, and {{hl|orange|4.8%}} with Glow Up.
* {{V|Illusion}} can generate Polychrome playing cards, but is not affected by Hone or Glow Up.
* {{spectral|Aura}} has a {{hl|orange|15%}} chance to add Polychrome to a selected playing card.
* {{Tarot|The Wheel of Fortune}} has a {{hl|orange|15%}} chance to add Polychrome to a random Joker if it activates.
* {{spectral|Hex}} applies Polychrome to a random Joker and destroys all other non-{{Sticker|Eternal}} Jokers. If only 1 Joker is owned, Hex is guaranteed to apply Polychrome to that specific Joker.
* The {{Tag|Polychrome}} applies Polychrome to the next base edition joker in the shop and makes it free.
* {{Tarot|Death}}, {{Spectral|Cryptid}}, and {{J|DNA}} can duplicate Polychrome playing cards.
* {{Spectral|Ankh}} and {{J|Invisible Joker}} are able to duplicate Polychrome Jokers.

== Synergies ==
=== [[Seals]] ===
*{{Seal|Red|name=Red Seals|image=Ace of Spades (Polychrome).png}} retrigger playing cards 1 additional time, which gives {{xmult|2.25}} if that card is polychrome.

=== [[Jokers]] ===
*{{J|Hanging Chad}} can give {{xmult|3.375}} if your first scored card is Polychrome. While Hanging Chad is best utilized early game when Polychrome cards in your deck are limited, it can still be viable well into endless.
*{{J|Sock and Buskin}}, {{J|Dusk}}, {{J|Hack}}, and {{J|Seltzer}} can retrigger your played Polychrome cards, essentially doubling Polychrome's effect. While all of these are viable, {{J|Sock and Buskin}} and {{J|Hack}} are the best as they can be utilized multiple times per round and are not consumed.
*Jokers with exponential scaling potential such as {{J|Triboulet}} and {{J|The Idol}} are both ideal Jokers to pair with Polychrome cards, providing a significant amount of extra xMult, especially when retriggered.
*{{J|Photograph}} is great if you have Polychrome face cards, or have {{J|Pareidolia}} to trigger its effect on a non-face Polychrome card.
*{{J|Invisible Joker}} can copy a Polychrome Joker, the new Joker will keep the Polychrome edition.
=== [[Consumables]] ===
*{{spectral|Ectoplasm}} allows for an extra Joker to be utilized, and its {{hl|orange|-1}} hand size is not much of a downside if your deck is comprised multiple copies of 1 card. Because Polychrome cards only activate when scored, there is no need to have a large hand size.
*{{spectral|Ankh}} can copy a Polychrome Joker. If that Joker is {{Sticker|Eternal}}, then multiple copies of a Polychrome Joker can be made with Ankh.

== Usage notes ==
* Polychrome Jokers score at the same time as other Jokers in your Joker slots, including jokers such as {{J|Even Steven}}, who trigger when a card is scored. It's best to move your Polychrome Jokers to the ''right'' of any additive Mult Jokers.
* If Polychrome is on a card that gives additive Mult, the additive Mult will be added first, ''then'' the Polychrome will multiply the result by {{xmult|1.5}}. (E.g, {{J|Joker}} would give +4 Mult, then give {{xmult|1.5}})
